s.g: Of little monetary worth.
s.x: Could someone hope to survive on such a paltry income?

s.g: Despicable; contemptibly unimportant.
s.x: a paltry coward

s.g: (marine biology) A vertical pillar along the inner septal margin of a coral.
(planetology) A small plain (compared to mare) on the surface of a planet or satellite.
(historical) Any of the ranks in the hierarchy of gladiators.
Synonym of Palouse (“tribe”).
(heraldry) Palewise; vertically striped.
(poetic) Pale; lacking colour.
Of or pertaining to palynology.
(sciences) The scientific study of spores, pollen and particulate organic matter in various matrices including the air (pollen counts), crime scenes, and sedimentary rocks.
(paleontology) An organic microfossil: a particle of 5–500 micrometers in diameter, found in sedimentary deposits and composed of organic material.
(botany) Any spore (derived from fungi, algae or spore-bearing embryophytes) or pollen grain (derived from seed-bearing embryophytes).
